### alula.c1: Patagial membrane stretching between limbs on leaps

Trait ← Dense air (1.6 bar) creates high drag and low terminal velocity ← Falls are survivable; gliding is energetically cheap ← Membranes evolve to convert falls into forward travel ← Gliding reduces energy cost of traversing steep terrain ← F4

- **Skill:** Glide (Basic): Leaps from height and glides; covers distance without stamina cost; allows escape from ground chases.
- **Weakness:** Ground movement is slow; gales and turbulence can ground it or blow it off course.
- **Observe:**
  1. Leaps from cliff, stretches skin between limbs, and glides silently.
  2. Landing is soft and controlled; no heavy thud.
  3. Creature perches on high spires and drops to food.
- **Journal:** It falls only when it chooses, riding the heavy air.
- **Plausibility:** plausible (judge astrobio/autoloop-2026-11-18, 2026-11-18)
